schema.description: Per-entrypoint resource budgets for tipjar contract. All dimensions have a tolerance of +5% for regressions.

dimensions.cpu_instructions: CPU instruction count measured via env.budget()
dimensions.event_bytes: Total bytes in all emitted events

init.description: One-time contract initialization. Writes instance storage (token address).
init.notes: Write-heavy: sets Token in instance storage + TTL bump. No reads (first-call). Instance storage is cheapest ledger tier.

tip_first_time.description: First tip for a creator (cold storage, new keys). Two persistent reads (returns 0), two writes (new balance/total), token transfer.
tip_first_time.notes: Cold storage allocation is expensive. Three writes: CreatorBalance, CreatorTotal, instance TTL. Token transfer dominates cost.

tip_repeat.description: Subsequent tips for a creator (warm storage, existing keys).
tip_repeat.notes: Warm storage is cheaper than cold. Reads existing balance/total, updates in place, bumps TTL on both + instance.

get_total_tips.description: Read-only query for creator's historical total tips.
get_total_tips.notes: Pure read, no storage writes. No TTL bump (read-only). Returns 0 if key missing.

withdraw.description: Creator withdrawal: reads balance, zeroes it, transfers tokens.
withdraw.notes: Reads balance, sets to 0, bumps both balance key and instance TTL. Token transfer dominates. Historical total untouched.

wasm_size.description: Release WASM with opt-level=z, LTO enabled, target wasm32v1-none. Measured post-optimization via stellar contract optimize.
wasm_size.notes: Budget: <150KB. Current: 98KB with headroom for feature additions.

network_limits.description: Soroban network limits as of ledger protocol ~21. Documented for context; per-operation budgets must stay well under these.
